problem_statement: The device-mode classification for a Minimal End Device (MED) is computed incorrectly. When a device is not rx-on-when-idle and is not a full thread device (a sleepy end device / SED), the system still reports it as a Minimal End Device. The classification should report Minimal End Device only when the device is not a full thread device AND is rx-on-when-idle, so that an SED is not reported as a MED. This also affects routing of messages to end devices: a non-rx-on device should not be treated via the end-device parent-rloc16 path.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
